name: levy_1v1_passive
description: A player who never fights back: from the spawn, walk toward the Corridor A levy, lock on, stop, and stand while it attacks. It measures the levy's windup (enemy_melee_telegraph) and its damage per hit (ttk_levy_player, projected from the hits taken), which levy_1v1_sensible no longer can: its player dodges every swing.
